check.description: Markup parses cleanly: no duplicate IDs, complete start/end tags, correct nesting. REMOVED in WCAG 2.2 (deemed always-satisfied by modern parsers); retained here for 2.0/2.1 mapping — the P-2 duplicate-ID probe is the practical consumer.

sources.internal_policy_ref: HSBC digital accessibility framework — WCAG 2.2 AA minimum, governed by Group Digital Experience and Accessibility (mandatory on all HSBC digital projects).
